age.evidence: assessed for anxiety behavior on the open field test (OFT) (P90) and elevated plus maze (EPM) (P100)... subjected to gene expression analysis in the prefrontal cortex in adulthood (P110)

sex.evidence: Male Sprague-Dawley rats bred in the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research animal facility... male pups were group housed into adulthood

dosing.doses_raw: DOI (2 mg/kg) orally from P2 to P21
dosing.evidence: pups received DOI (2 mg/kg, Sigma-Aldrich) orally from P2 to P21 (PNDOI) or vehicle (5% sucrose) (Ctrl)

handling.evidence: paper mentions 'within 3 minutes to minimize handling stress' for drug administration but does not describe a separate handling habituation protocol

group_housing.evidence: male pups were group housed into adulthood

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12-hour light-dark cycle... behavioral tests were carried out within the light phase

assays.assay_description: Open field arena (100 x 100 x 70 cm), dim illumination, 5-min recording of exploratory behavior in adulthood (P90); measured total distance, path length, time and visits to center, and rears. Used to assess effect of postnatal DOI on anxiety.

application_type.evidence: pups received DOI (2 mg/kg, Sigma-Aldrich) orally from P2 to P21

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were released at one corner of the arena and exploratory behavior was recorded

food_restriction.evidence: no food in the OFT apparatus during recording

water_restriction.evidence: no water in the OFT apparatus during recording

time_to_assay.evidence: pups received DOI... from P2 to P21... assessed for anxiety behavior in the open field test (OFT) (P90)

outcomes.summary: Chronic postnatal DOI treatment (P2-P21) increased anxiety-like behavior in adulthood, with significantly decreased percent path length and percent time in the center of the OFT arena, and a trend toward fewer center visits.
outcomes.statistics: Student t test; percent path length and percent time in center significantly decreased (p<.05); number of visits trend p=.08
outcomes.evidence: Postnatal DOI animals showed a significant decline in percent path length (Figure 3C), percent time spent (Figure 3D), and a trend (p = .08) toward a decline in the number of visits (Figure 3E) to the center of the OFT arena.

B1_num_measures.evidence: We assessed total distance covered within the arena, path length, and time spent in the center; number of visits to the center; and number of rears in the arena.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: exploratory behavior was recorded with an automated tracking system for 5 minutes (single total measure)

B4_ethological.evidence: number of rears in the arena

B5_social.evidence: individual testing in OFT; no social component

B6_cognitive.evidence: Open field test analysis for anxiety behavior

B7_automated_classification.evidence: All behavioral tracks were analyzed using the Ethovision tracking system

B8_multivariate.evidence: univariate ANOVA and t tests only

E1_environment_type.evidence: the arena (100 cm x 100 cm x 70 cm) was placed in a dimly illuminated room

E6_spatial.evidence: arena (100 cm x 100 cm x 70 cm)

E7_social_context.evidence: Animals were released at one corner of the arena

D1_continuity.evidence: exploratory behavior was recorded with an automated tracking system for 5 minutes

D4_baseline.evidence: no pre-drug baseline recording in OFT

D5_followup.evidence: DOI administered P2-P21; OFT performed at P90, well over 24h after last dose

assays.assay_description: EPM elevated 50 cm with two open and two closed arms (45 x 10 cm); 5-min recording at P100. Measured total distance, path length, time in open/closed arms, number of rears. Used to assess effect of postnatal DOI on anxiety.

application_type.evidence: pups received DOI (2 mg/kg, Sigma-Aldrich) orally from P2 to P21

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were released into the center of the maze facing the open arm

food_restriction.evidence: no food in EPM apparatus during recording

water_restriction.evidence: no water in EPM apparatus during recording

time_to_assay.evidence: pups received DOI... from P2 to P21... elevated plus maze (EPM) (P100)

outcomes.summary: Postnatal DOI treatment evoked anxiety-like behavior on the EPM in adulthood, with significant decreases in percent path length in the open arms and increased percent path length in the closed arms; percent time in closed arms showed a trend toward increase (p=.07).
outcomes.statistics: Student t test; significant differences for percent path length open and closed arms; trend p=.07 for time in closed arms
outcomes.evidence: PNDOI animals showed a significant decrease in percent path length in the open arms (Figure 3H), increased percent path length in the closed arm (Figure 3I), and a trend (p = .07) toward an increase in time spent in the closed arms (Figure 3J)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Analysis was performed for total distance covered within the maze, path length, and time spent in the open and closed arms and the number of rears in the maze.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: behavioral measures were assessed for 5 minutes (single total)

B4_ethological.evidence: number of rears in the maze

B6_cognitive.evidence: Elevated plus maze analysis for anxiety behavior

B7_automated_classification.evidence: All behavioral tracks were analyzed using the Ethovision tracking system

E1_environment_type.evidence: platform elevated 50 cm from the ground with two open and closed arms (45 x 10 cm)

E2_shelter.evidence: EPM closed arms are part of the apparatus design, not a shelter

E6_spatial.evidence: Per rubric: EPM arms are open-ended extensions of a central platform, not distinct enclosed compartments

E7_social_context.evidence: Animals were released into the center of the maze

D1_continuity.evidence: behavioral measures were assessed for 5 minutes

D5_followup.evidence: DOI dosing P2-P21; EPM at P100, well >24 h post last dose

judge_notes: Only DOI is a psychedelic; fluoxetine, ketanserin, MDL100907, SB242084, and WAY-100635 are not psychedelics, so only the DOI (PNDOI) experiments are scored as psychedelic-administered assays.
Two assays retained: OFT (P90) and EPM (P100) for the PNDOI cohort. FST was not performed on the DOI cohort.
B4 scored Yes for rears (an ethological behavior explicitly measured in both OFT and EPM); candidates split on this and qwen's interpretation matches the paper's reported measures.
Ethovision is explicitly listed in the rubric as position-tracking (B7=0).
